title.zh: 合作社（AUPE 信用合作社有限公司——第 97 条豁免）命令 2022
title.en: Co-operative Societies (AUPE Credit Co-operative Limited — Exemption under Section 97) Order 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Co‑operative Societies (AUPE Credit Co‑operative Limited — Exemption under Section 97) Order 2022 and comes into operation on 11 October 2022.

2.—(1) AUPE Credit Co‑operative Limited (called in this paragraph AUPE CC), a primary society, is exempt from the requirement in section 39(1)(a)(ii) of the Act that membership in a primary society for an individual is to be restricted to individuals who are citizens of Singapore or resident in Singapore, to the extent provided in sub‑paragraph (2).
(2) AUPE CC may admit an employee of the Public Utilities Board who is both a citizen of Malaysia and resident in Malaysia as a member of AUPE CC, even though he or she is neither a citizen of Singapore nor resident in Singapore.
